Create a webhook and print its signing secret, shown only this once. Asks for what is missing on a
terminal.

A production webhook receives the purchase events of production keys; a test webhook those of store
sandbox and test purchases. Person events reach both.

Events: purchase.completed, purchase.refunded, purchase.revoked, subscription.created,
subscription.renewed, subscription.product_changed, subscription.cancelled, subscription.expired,
person.deleted. purchase.*, subscription.* and person.* name a group, and all every event that is
sent.

Usage:
  voidhash webhook create [flags]

Flags:
      --description <description>  A note for your team
      --environment <production|test>
                                   Which purchase events it receives: production (default), or test
                                   for a staging backend
      --event <event>              An event to send, such as purchase.completed, a group such as
                                   subscription.*, or all; repeat for each (can be repeated)
  -h, --help                       Show help for this command
      --json                       Print the API objects as JSON, for scripts
      --name <name>                What it is for, such as Orders backend
      --project <project>          Project to act on: its id, slug, organization/slug or name
                                   (default: this directory's project, then your default project)
  -q, --quiet                      Print only ids, one per line
      --url <url>                  The public URL Voidhash POSTs events to

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash webhook create --name "Orders backend" --url https://example.com/webhooks/voidhash --event purchase.* --event subscription.renewed
  voidhash webhook create --name Staging --url https://staging.example.com/hooks --event all --environment test
